punchline: Pink found people spend about 24 minutes of every working hour trying to move someone, yet the first word they link to sales is "pushy".
thirty_sec: Pink had workers surveyed about their day. About 24 minutes of every hour went to persuading and convincing, with nothing being sold. Teachers, nurses and startup founders all do it. Yet when people were asked about "sales", 20 of the top 25 words were negative, led by "pushy".
